about: Clean OS house look (fixed: one house look per style, small variation per reel). The build uses these; only content changes per reel.

cards.variant: QuickType suggestion tapped into the card (on choice words only)

emphasis_device: red Figma selection box with a cursor (focus / reject)
signature_word: Markup pen (Marck Script) with nib and tool palette
accent_rule: one per reel from the palette, by topic (craft/warmth orange, digital blue, health/done green)
insert_frame: Photos-style card on a blurred page
sound: one small native UI sound per graphic entrance, nothing on bare cuts, ambient bed ~-12 dB
grade_rule: reference data only, never applied to the speaker's face: the footage stays as shot and the inserts are conformed to it; broll_qa.py as_shot fails a regraded plate
components_rule: the house look is the type, captions, accents, insert framing and the speaker's face as shot; phone-UI scenes, paper props, polaroid / card / collage treatments, transitions, hook and outro devices are NEW every reel (scripts/components.py plan / check / record, catalog.json)

scene_transition.in: app opens from its icon BELOW the chin (power2.in, <= 0.25 s, content from frame one)
